Description
These coins have some of the smallest amounts of pure gold that you will be able to find in modern coins. This comes with several benefits such as the investor being able to buy several of these coins for themselves at a low price over time. These coins are also a great place to start off a younger generation with investment knowledge. Each one of these gold coins features a kangaroo by a fence in the famous outback. These noble animals are looking off to one side and have an incredible amount of detail worked into them. This side of the coin features the weight, year, and purity of the gold contained within, .9999. On the reverse side of the coin is Queen Elizabeth II with the words Australia and the denomination that the money is worth. Overall, these coins are a very smart initial investment for the person who wants to save up smaller amounts of wealth over time.
